title: Quarantine native-derived address fields in x25519.json + gcp3_trust_models.json
description: Slice of q6ko discovered during q6ko.1 recon: test/vectors/x25519.json and test/vectors/gcp3_trust_models.json embed ygg_addr/native-profile-derived address fields from the rejected SHA-512 native profile (grep 'ygg_addr|native_packed'). Survey consumers (python tests / rust / C), then apply the q6ko quarantine decision consistently with the ipv6-addresses.json sibling (q6ko.3): label or move the native-derived fields so nothing presents the rejected profile as a live conformance oracle. Do not weaken pinned upstream byte-equality vectors; do not migrate the derivation itself.
